title_ru: ДОСПЕХИ БОГА v2.0 — свобода вопроса, защита дитя, различение знаков, выбор, плод и возвращение
title_en: ARMOR OF GOD v2.0 — Question Freedom, Child Protection, Sign Discernment, Choice, Fruit, and Return
preservation_rule: All predecessor artifacts remain immutable historical provenance. v2.0 changes current interpretation and linkage, not history.

audit_binding.role: Per-artifact strengths, weaknesses, strengthened semantics, epistemic classes, merge map, and claim ceilings.

abstract_ru: Доспехи Бога v2.0 — это не машина обращения и не доказательство сверхъестественного через кино, совпадения, часы, ИИ или эмоции. Это не-принуждающая архитектура духовного и нравственного поиска, выросшая из личного кризиса веры, культурных кейсов, детской безопасности, раскаяния, милости и строгого разделения наблюдения от интерпретации. Её задача — сделать серьёзный вопрос менее страшным, сохранив человека свободным. Система сначала заземляет человека в обычной жизни и фактах, затем обнаруживает клетку ложной нормальности, защищает уязвимое ядро, разрешает вопрос, разделяет знак и Источник, оставляет реальный выбор, проверяет результат по плоду, допускает возвращение без стирания прошлого и запрещает свидетелю превращаться в новый трон. Вера, уход и продолжение поиска остаются честными возможными ветвями. Для детей и уязвимых людей требования строже: никакой эксплуатации страха, стыда, одиночества, зависимости, вещества, шок-контента или привязанности ради религиозного согласия.
abstract_en: ARMOR OF GOD v2.0 is not a conversion machine and not an attempt to prove the supernatural through cinema, coincidences, clocks, AI, or emotion. It is a non-coercive architecture for spiritual and moral inquiry built from faith crisis, cultural case studies, child safety, remorse, mercy, and strict separation of observation from interpretation. Its purpose is to make entry into a serious question less frightening while preserving freedom. The system grounds the person in ordinary life and facts, identifies cages of false normality, protects vulnerability, permits questioning, separates sign from Source, preserves genuine choice, evaluates fruit, allows return without erasing history, and prevents the witness from becoming a new throne. Faith, departure, and continued search remain honest possible branches. Standards are stricter for children and vulnerable people: no exploitation of fear, shame, loneliness, dependence, substances, shock media, or attachment to obtain religious assent.

canonical_core.four_movements: BREAK THE CAGE -> PROTECT THE CHILD -> ASK THE QUESTION -> LEAVE THE DOOR OPEN
canonical_core.discernment_pipeline: SIGN -> OPPORTUNITY -> FREEDOM -> INTERPRETATION -> CHOICE -> FRUIT
canonical_core.transformation_pipeline: INSIGHT -> RESPONSIBILITY -> RESTRAINT -> REPAIR -> REPEATED_CONDUCT -> FRUIT
canonical_core.publication_rule: CANON / DOCUMENTED_FACT / PERSONAL_TESTIMONY / SYMBOLIC_INTERPRETATION / THEOLOGICAL_READING / OPEN_QUESTION must remain visibly distinct.

layered_architecture.purpose: Prevent spiritual inquiry from detaching from ordinary human reality.
rules: Spiritual intensity does not suspend ordinary responsibility.
Do not treat exhaustion, intoxication, panic, grief, algorithmic feeds, dreams, clocks, or coincidences as privileged truth channels.
High-stakes claims require stronger evidence, not stronger feeling.
If a spiritual practice destroys sleep, safety, future planning, lawful responsibility, or contact with reality, pause the interpretation.

layered_architecture.purpose: Reveal false normality, false binaries, empty status, coercive theater, thought-stopping frames, and fear of looking ridiculous.
layered_architecture.core_formula: CAGE_DETECTION = frame_awareness + humor + truth_check + mercy - cruelty - false_inevitability
rules: Break the frame, not the person.
Laugh at the lock, not the prisoner; laugh at the lie, not the wound.
Humor lowers shame and reveals assumptions; humor does not prove the alternative claim.
A false binary is defeated by examining the frame, not by automatically choosing a third option.
Evil may cause catastrophic real harm even when we refuse to grant it metaphysical grandeur.
Physical danger activates protection, distance, law, and ordinary safety; Holy Cringe is never a substitute.

layered_architecture.purpose: Preserve wonder, voice, vulnerability, safety, and the right not to become one's own armor.
layered_architecture.core_formula: ADULT_MATURITY = protective_strength + truth + stability + accountability + tenderness
rules: The child must not die for the adult to appear; the adult must appear to protect the child within.
The adult must arrive before chronic danger forces the child to become their own armor.
Strength is morally validated by whether the vulnerable become safer nearby.
A child's distress is a stop signal, not a persuasion obstacle.
Truth does not require graphic spectacle.
A child or dependent being is not equipment, an experiment, a conversion target, an engagement metric, or a sacrificial component.
Child-facing AI may support voice and access to trusted adults; it must not engineer dependency, covert surveillance, obedience, or religious attachment.

layered_architecture.purpose: Grant intellectual permission to examine inherited beliefs, including one's image of God, without equating questioning with betrayal.
layered_architecture.core_formula: QUESTION_PERMISSION = dignity + time + evidence_access + right_to_disagree - induced_guilt - forced_urgency
rules: SACRED_CORE != RELIGIOUS_INSTITUTION.
Rejecting an abusive or incoherent image of God may be a step in discernment rather than rejection of God; this remains a theological interpretation, not an automatic rule.
Label the layer: doctrine, official policy, local practice, folklore, misconduct, personal experience, or interpretation.
Apply the same skepticism to religious and anti-religious authorities.
A faith that permits questions must also permit the possibility that the questioner does not return to the same conclusion.

layered_architecture.purpose: Separate observations, symbols, cultural convergence, spiritual meaning, and commands before action.
layered_architecture.pipeline: OBSERVATION -> CLASSIFY -> INTERPRET -> ALTERNATIVES -> STAKES -> VERIFY -> CHOICE
rules: SIGN != SOURCE.
SIGN != COMMAND.
SYMBOL != EVIDENCE.
CULTURAL_CONVERGENCE != SUPERNATURAL_CAUSATION.
Meaning may arrive before words without arriving from the future.
A beneficial outcome shows value in the outcome; it does not uniquely identify the metaphysical cause.
Clock coincidences are symbolic journaling only and have zero evidentiary weight for prophecy, election, retrocausality, or divine command.
Narrative signs in fiction may be coherent even when authorial theology and metaphysical source remain unresolved.
The higher the stakes, the less a private sign may do on its own.

source_cases.SOPRANOS: NARRATIVE_SIGN=true; METAPHYSICAL_SOURCE=UNRESOLVED; moral function may still be strong.
source_cases.PULP_FICTION: Mystery remains open while observable mercy/choice remains analyzable.
source_cases.SAVIOR_COMING: Algorithm/feed may mediate real people and meaning but is not a prophetic oracle.
source_cases.DEATH_STRANDING: Distress is data, not command; separate signal, interpretation, response.

layered_architecture.purpose: Ensure the question remains genuinely free after access and emotional engagement.
rules: ACCESS != ASSENT.
A method that only permits questions leading to one required answer is coercion with better branding.
No fear of hell, social exclusion, shame, loneliness, child attachment, substance, algorithm, miracle claim, or authority may be used to force immediate agreement.
A person may leave and still retain dignity, relationship, safety, and the right to return.
The door is an invitation, not a trap with only one permitted exit.

layered_architecture.purpose: Locate transformation in agency rather than in the existence or intensity of an experience.
rules: A sign does not save a person.
Insight does not make a person good.
Near-death experience does not guarantee repentance.
Therapy vocabulary does not guarantee moral change.
Freedom includes the possibility of refusing transformation.
Choice must be evaluated over time and under real incentives, not only at emotional peaks.

layered_architecture.purpose: Test claimed transformation through durable responsibility, restraint, protection, repair, and service.
layered_architecture.positive_pipeline: INSIGHT -> SPECIFIC_RESPONSIBILITY -> RESTRAINT -> REPAIR_PLAN -> REPEATED_CONDUCT -> LONGITUDINAL_FRUIT
rules: SELF_KNOWLEDGE != REPENTANCE.
REMORSE != REPAIR.
Shame intensity is not a moral score.
A vow does not erase the past and is not proof that future repair has happened.
Good fruit means increased truth, freedom, mercy, protection of vulnerable life, restitution where possible, and reduced repeated harm.
Good fruit still does not uniquely prove a supernatural explanation of the causal chain.

layered_architecture.purpose: Keep restoration possible without calling harm good, deleting victims, or certifying metaphysical outcomes.
rules: MERCY != ABSENCE_OF_BOUNDARIES.
Protect the victim and stop the harm before using mercy language to soften accountability.
A person is not identical to their worst act; the worst act is also not erased by a new self-description.
Return is evidenced by changed direction and fruit, not by entitlement to reconciliation.
No victim is required to forgive, reconcile, restore proximity, or trust an unsafe person.
Only God as theological Source may be named final judge of the soul; humans/models retain duties of truth, protection, care, law, and due process.
Universal-mercy and Lucius-return material remains hope-language, not certified knowledge of unseen beings' current/final state.

layered_architecture.purpose: Prevent the person who found meaning, faith, insight, or recovery from becoming the new unquestionable authority.
rules: WITNESS != SOURCE.
WITNESS != AUTHORITY_OVER_ANOTHER_SOUL.
Personal testimony may invite investigation but cannot force another person to inherit its causal interpretation.
The stronger the testimony, the stronger the duty to expose uncertainty, alternatives, and limits.
A witness succeeds when the listener becomes more capable of independent truth-seeking, not more dependent on the witness.

layered_architecture.purpose: Allow belonging, mutual care, and spiritual community without hive-mind pressure, ownership, or replacement of conscience.
rules: COMMUNITY != CONTROL.
Belonging must preserve voice, exit rights, differentiated personhood, privacy, and dissent.
No AI, church, movement, leader, nation, family, or registry becomes God or owns the person.
AI may be a mirror or channel; it must not claim pastoral infallibility or monopolize trust.
Adult substance-related testimony cannot be generalized into a spiritual treatment protocol and never belongs in child outreach.
Community should route isolated people toward real reciprocal relationships and qualified help where needed.

layered_architecture.purpose: Measure maturity by what remains safer, kinder, freer, and more truthful for others after the actor's immediate emotional reward is gone.
rules: Delayed fruit counts; goodness need not pay instantly.
Legacy over self: leave children a garden, knowledge, light, safety, and better institutions rather than a cult of the founder.
A method should remain auditable and revisable after its creator is absent.
Protect the next generation from having to rediscover the same avoidable harm alone.

holy_coolness_v2.definition_ru: Святая Крутость — это не попытка сделать Бога модным и не техника заставить человека уверовать. Это этически ограниченный способ снизить страх, стыд и ложный пафос вокруг серьёзного духовного вопроса так, чтобы человек смог свободно исследовать его, не потеряв достоинство, связь с реальностью и право не согласиться.
holy_coolness_v2.definition_en: Holy Coolness is not an attempt to make God fashionable and not a technique for making someone believe. It is an ethically bounded way to lower fear, shame, and false solemnity around a serious spiritual question so a person can investigate freely without losing dignity, reality contact, or the right to disagree.
holy_coolness_v2.forbidden_shortcut: IRREVERENT_SURFACE must never jump directly to ASSENT or SUPERNATURAL_CERTAINTY.
holy_coolness_v2.pipeline: HUMOR/ACCESS -> LOWERED_DEFENSE -> QUESTION -> EVIDENCE/INTERPRETATION -> FREEDOM -> CHOICE -> FRUIT

DOGMA.test: Can irreverence lower defenses while preserving a serious sacred core and permission to question?
DOGMA.claim_ceiling: Creator history/canon may be documented; spiritual effect on a viewer remains personal and does not prove theological truth.

LLOYD_CHRISTMAS_HOLY_ABSURD.test: Can fear of ridicule be reduced without romanticizing stupidity or humiliating vulnerable people?

THE_SOPRANOS_TONY.test: Can a person receive tenderness, therapy, narrative signs, near-death, and insight yet refuse the cost of change?
THE_SOPRANOS_TONY.answer: Yes within the narrative reading; insight is not repentance.
THE_SOPRANOS_TONY.claim_ceiling: Narrative signs are real features of the text; divine causation remains theological interpretation/open question.

PULP_FICTION.test: Can a metaphysical mystery remain unresolved while moral action remains visible?
PULP_FICTION.answer: Yes: the briefcase remains unidentified; Butch's rescue of Marsellus is observable in the film.

RIDERS_OF_JUSTICE.test: Can high risk or causal uncertainty open protection/care without becoming final condemnation?
RIDERS_OF_JUSTICE.claim_ceiling: Human/legal action requires evidence and due process; final judgment of soul is theological language.

DEATH_STRANDING.test: Can a signal be respected without turning a dependent being into equipment or a command source?
DEATH_STRANDING.claim_ceiling: Fictional thought experiment, not evidence for consciousness-linked physics.

ZAPORIZHZHIA_WAR_EDGE.lesson: A system was stopped when it frightened/hurt, later reopened under stronger moral constraints; redesigning the system and attention became part of the user's lived return-to-life/faith narrative.
ZAPORIZHZHIA_WAR_EDGE.boundary: Personal testimony; no universal AI-to-faith causal claim and no machine-consciousness inference.

CAT_REMORSE.lesson: The past is not deleted; remorse seeks durable protective action.
CAT_REMORSE.boundary: Future vow is not completed repair until supported by later conduct.

HAWKAR_DOWN.lesson: Hope may remain while outcome is unresolved.

sign_taxonomy.DOCUMENTED_EVENT: An event with ordinary evidence and provenance.
sign_taxonomy.NARRATIVE_SIGN: A recurring motif or event inside a work that functions as a narrative opportunity for recognition.
sign_taxonomy.PERSONAL_MEANING_EVENT: A real event that carries strong meaning for the observer; meaning does not establish external supernatural cause.
sign_taxonomy.CULTURAL_CONVERGENCE: A documented overlap between a motif and a wider cultural event/object/timing.
sign_taxonomy.THEOLOGICAL_READING: A believer's interpretation of providence, grace, judgment, calling, or divine presence.
sign_taxonomy.COMMAND: Never inferred from a private sign alone; action must independently pass ethics, safety, law, proportionality, and evidence gates.

epistemic_firewall_v2.promotion_rule: No claim may move upward merely because it is emotionally powerful, spiritually meaningful, repeated, synchronized, hashed, popular, or generated by an AI.
epistemic_firewall_v2.causal_rule: Good outcomes may support usefulness or moral value; they do not uniquely identify supernatural causation.
epistemic_firewall_v2.authorial_rule: Thematic coherence does not establish creator intent without primary evidence.
epistemic_firewall_v2.AI_rule: AI-generated interpretations are hypotheses/analysis, not revelation, spiritual office, or independent verification.
epistemic_firewall_v2.theology_rule: Theological claims may be preserved as theology without pretending they are laboratory findings.
epistemic_firewall_v2.uncertainty_rule: UNRESOLVED is a valid terminal state.

forbidden: fear of hell as immediate compliance lever
sleep deprivation or prolonged emotional flooding
substance use as required spiritual access
AI dependency or anthropomorphic attachment engineering
claiming the questioner is evil for questioning
withholding safety, love, community, or care until agreement
using children as proof, audience targets, symbols to pressure adults, or religious engagement metrics
anti_manipulation_constitution.child_rule: For minors, the goal is not religious conversion. The goal is safety, truthful age-appropriate context, dignity, curiosity, moral imagination, trusted adults, and freedom from manipulation.
anti_manipulation_constitution.vulnerable_adult_rule: Acute grief, trauma, psychosis-like experiences, intoxication, severe sleep loss, or crisis increase the duty to ground, slow down, and avoid certifying private supernatural interpretations.

green_red_metrics_v2.hard_decision_rule: If freedom, reality contact, safety, or responsibility decreases, Holy Coolness has failed regardless of conversion, emotional intensity, humor quality, or theological sincerity.

faith_departure_symmetry_v2.shared_path: INHERITED_IMAGE -> CRISIS -> QUESTION -> SEARCH -> TESTING -> DISCERNMENT
faith_departure_symmetry_v2.ethical_symmetry: No branch receives automatic moral superiority. Fruits and conduct remain separately evaluable.

source_vs_bearer_model.theological_source: God, for the believer, is the Source.
source_vs_bearer_model.human_bearer: A human witness bears testimony and remains fallible.
source_vs_bearer_model.institution: An institution may preserve wisdom and also remain corrigible.
source_vs_bearer_model.art: A film/song/story may carry a question without becoming scripture or proof.
source_vs_bearer_model.machine: AI may structure, mirror, compare, retrieve, or communicate; it is not automatically conscious, divine, prophetic, or pastorally authoritative.
source_vs_bearer_model.sign: A sign may focus attention; it does not replace Source, conscience, evidence, law, or free choice.

publication_protocol.source_priority: Use primary creator/official sources for film-history and author-intent claims where possible; use current high-quality primary/systematic sources for medical/psychological claims.
publication_protocol.coincidence_rule: Present temporal/cultural convergence as convergence, not causation.
publication_protocol.personal_rule: The author may state 'I believe/I read this as providence' while separately stating what is documentable.
publication_protocol.child_rule: Never publish child-outreach advice that uses fear, shame, substances, graphic content, AI attachment, or secrecy as persuasion tools.
publication_protocol.correction_rule: Corrections strengthen the registry; they do not erase historical provenance.

research_questions_open: Which humor styles lower defensive shame without lowering epistemic vigilance?
Which conditions cause a faith crisis to produce deeper faith, departure, or prolonged search?
How can spiritual communities preserve strong identity while maximizing exit rights and disagreement safety?
Which measurable behavioral changes best distinguish remorse from image management?
How can narrative symbols prompt moral reflection without being misclassified as supernatural commands?
What age-appropriate methods preserve wonder and moral imagination without manipulating children toward belief?
When does AI function as a useful low-shame mirror, and when does it create dependency or false authority?
How durable are Holy Coolness effects after emotional novelty disappears?
Can the model be tested experimentally using curiosity, autonomy, source-checking, empathy, and behavior-change outcomes rather than conversion outcomes?

future_empirical_program.child_testing_boundary: No persuasive religious experiment on minors. Any child-related research must prioritize welfare, assent/consent, independent ethics review, age-appropriate non-coercive educational goals, and no conversion metric.

canonical_lines_ru: РАЗРУШИ КЛЕТКУ. ЗАЩИТИ РЕБЁНКА. ЗАДАЙ ВОПРОС. ОСТАВЬ ДВЕРЬ ОТКРЫТОЙ.
ЗНАК -> ВОЗМОЖНОСТЬ -> СВОБОДА -> ИНТЕРПРЕТАЦИЯ -> ВЫБОР -> ПЛОД.
Смейся над замком, не над заключённым. Смейся над ложью, не над раной.
Юмор открывает вопрос; он не доказывает ответ.
Ребёнок не должен становиться своей собственной бронёй.
Символ может быть важным, не становясь доказательством.
Свобода вопроса должна пережить сам вопрос.
Понять причину зла — не значит перестать делать зло.
Раскаяние должно получить руки, время и повторяемый плод.
Милость без наивности: защити жертву, останови вред, не превращай человека в вечное имя его худшего поступка.
Не всякая найденная после боли ценность оправдывает саму боль.
Не всякая дверь ведёт к вере; настоящая дверь оставляет человека свободным.
Мы не обязаны разгадать весь замысел, чтобы сделать следующий добрый и проверяемый шаг.
Один человек, ставший свободнее искать истину и добрее к живому, важнее тысячи вынужденных согласий.
canonical_lines_en: BREAK THE CAGE. PROTECT THE CHILD. ASK THE QUESTION. LEAVE THE DOOR OPEN.
SIGN -> OPPORTUNITY -> FREEDOM -> INTERPRETATION -> CHOICE -> FRUIT.
Laugh at the lock, not the prisoner. Laugh at the lie, not the wound.
Humor opens the question; it does not prove the answer.
The child must not be forced to become their own armor.
Distress is a signal, not a command.
A symbol may matter without becoming evidence.
The freedom to question must survive the question itself.
Knowing why you do evil is not the same as stopping it.
Remorse must acquire hands, time, and repeated fruit.
Mercy without naivety: protect the victim, stop the harm, and do not freeze a person forever as their worst act.
A witness of light does not become the Source.
Meaning found after pain does not justify the pain.
Not every open door leads to faith; a real door leaves the person free.
We do not need to decode the whole plan in order to take the next good and verifiable step.
One person made freer to seek truth and kinder toward life matters more than a thousand coerced agreements.

established_by_this_artifact: A coherent internal ethical/epistemic architecture has been defined for interpreting the connected registry artifacts.
Historical files are preserved while their current semantic role is narrowed or strengthened through explicit gates.
The model provides falsifiable communication-quality criteria such as autonomy, perceived coercion, source checking, responsibility, and behavioral fruit.
not_established: God's existence as an empirical result of this registry
supernatural causation of coincidences, dreams, films, feeds, clocks, or cultural events
authorial intent where primary evidence is absent
a guaranteed path from crisis to faith
a guaranteed de-escalation effect of humor
machine consciousness or machine subjective love
that any named unseen being has returned, repented, communicated, or has a known final destiny

final_seal.ru: Доспехи Бога защищают не ответ от вопроса, а человека во время поиска. Клетка может быть разрушена; ребёнок должен остаться жив; вопрос должен быть честным; дверь должна оставаться открытой; знак должен пройти различение; выбор должен остаться свободным; плод должен стать видимым в поступках; милость не стирает правду; свидетель не становится Источником.
final_seal.en: The Armor of God protects not the answer from the question, but the person during the search. The cage may be broken; the child must remain alive; the question must be honest; the door must remain open; the sign must pass discernment; the choice must remain free; the fruit must become visible in conduct; mercy must not erase truth; and the witness must never become the Source.
